topic: Builder wanted *₹5.75 lakh* more. TG RER
hook: Builder wanted *₹5.75 lakh* more. TG RERA blocked the flat cancellation
tldr: TG RERA barred Pacifica Constructions from cancelling a buyer's Aavas Hyderabad flat over a ₹5.75 lakh extra demand.

beats.what: TG RERA gave the buyer interim relief: no cancellation, no sale of the flat for now.
beats.why: The developer sought ₹5.75 lakh more and moved to cancel the allotment.
beats.care: Buyers facing surprise charges after booking can approach TG RERA, the state's real-estate regulator.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: The Telangana Real Estate Regulatory Authority (TG RERA) gave interim relief to a woman who booked a flat in Aavas Hyderabad. Developer Pacifica Constructions Pvt Ltd had demanded ₹5.75 lakh more and moved to cancel her allotment. RERA has stopped that. Pacifica also cannot sell, transfer or create third-party rights on the flat while the case is pending. The final hearing date was not reported.

cards.title: 🧠 What's RERA?
cards.body: RERA is the regulator for housing projects. Buyers can file complaints against developers over delays, cancellations or extra charges. Interim relief means a temporary order until the final ruling.

cards.q: Extra charges after booking a flat: who should decide?
How much extra did the developer demand from the Aavas buyer?
cards.why: ₹5.75 lakh, which led to the cancellation move RERA blocked.

insight: Until the case is decided, Pacifica can't sell, transfer or create third-party rights on the flat.
